fee_notes: Standard fee $30,000 for first center (ground-up or conversion). Second center: $20,000 ground-up or $5,000 conversion. Third+ center: $5,000 regardless of type. Development agreement: $2,500-$5,000 per center. Purchase from existing franchisee: $5,000 first, $2,500 subsequent. Actual fees collected last fiscal year ranged $1,250-$5,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay VIOCF a license fee of $30,000 for your first Center... During VIOCF's last fiscal year, it collected initial license fees ranging from $1,250 to $5,000 per Center.
